claim: On July 22, 2024 Amazon MQ added quorum queues, supported only on brokers using RabbitMQ version 3.13 and above. Quorum queues are a replicated FIFO queue type that uses the Raft consensus algorithm.
question: Since when does Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ support quorum queues, and on which versions?

qualifiers.scope: quorum queues on Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
